items.title: Gucci taglia il nastro del maxi flagship parigino in Avenue Montaigne
items.summary: Italian trade-press coverage of Gucci's ribbon-cutting for its new 1,480 sqm, four-floor flagship at 56 Avenue Montaigne, Paris, opened October 30. Frames the store as the first physical rollout of 'The Store Show' concept previewed at the September Milan runway, built on Italian Renaissance palazzo and Milanese-heritage design references, including a private Appartamento client space.

items.title: Who Made the Best Dressed at the 2026 LACMA Gala
items.summary: WWD's best-dressed roundup of the Nov 7 LACMA Art+Film Gala (presented by Gucci) highlights several Gucci-by-Demna looks, including Emily Ratajkowski's leg-slit gown and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley's backless gown, which the piece calls the season's defining backless look; frames Demna's continued 'sexmaxxing' styling direction as both a talking point and a risk for the brand's image reset.

items.title: Kering stock gains 1.37% after Balenciaga leadership reset
items.summary: German financial-wire note on Kering shares rising after news that Martine Rose replaces Pierpaolo Piccioli at sister brand Balenciaga; piece situates the move within Kering's broader 'Reconkering' restructuring under CEO Luca de Meo, alongside continuing scrutiny of Gucci's slower comparable-sales recovery and store-closure programme.

items.title: Gucci estrena imagen en la avenida Montaigne de Paris
items.summary: Spanish-language trade piece on the new Avenue Montaigne flagship, framing the store redesign explicitly as part of Gucci's turnaround effort to regain footing among European luxury shoppers after several years of sales declines and store-network contraction.

items.title: Gucci UK Trustpilot reviews -- ongoing customer-service and quality complaints
items.summary: Current UK Trustpilot review stream for gucci.com remains dominated by negative experiences: recurring complaints cite unhelpful or rude customer service, difficult/unsupportive returns handling, defective items and damaged packaging, an inability of the UK repair centre to fix the brand's own products, and one case where a return was refused over a missing tag the item never had.

items.title: Demna's Fashion Show Premier -- PurseForum member thread (ongoing)
items.summary: Active PurseForum thread on Demna's Gucci runway direction continues to draw mixed reviews; some members call recent collections 'referential to the point of being derivative,' sampling past Gucci eras without adding new commentary, while others say they are glad the house is leaning on its archive instead of a full reinvention.

items.title: Gucci official Instagram -- 'Gucci Gift' Holiday 2026 campaign post with Mariah Carey
items.summary: Gucci's own channel continues to run the Nov 2 Mariah Carey 'Gucci Gift' Butterfly-collection campaign (dir. Harmony Korine); public comments remain split between nostalgia-driven enthusiasm for the Butterfly-era callback and the critical pile-on reflected in press roundups below. Exact like/comment counts are not accessible without a paid Instagram connector.

items.source: Yahoo Entertainment (fan-reaction roundup, citing TikTok/X posts)
items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Continuing public backlash to Gucci's Mariah Carey holiday campaign: viewers call it 'emotionless,' 'boring,' and 'depressing,' with one TikTok comment reading the ad as feeling 'like if JCPenney was trying to be luxury' and another comparing the hotel-party setting to a horror-movie scene. A minority of commenters still defend Carey's star power even while panning the campaign's tone.

items.title: TikTok discover tags still circulating Gucci holiday-campaign reaction clips and LACMA gala edits
items.summary: TikTok discovery tags continue surfacing duet/reaction clips dissecting the Mariah Carey 'Gucci Gift' ad's tone (several framing it as 'uncanny' or comparing it to AHS-style horror aesthetics), alongside new edits of LACMA gala red-carpet looks by Rosie Huntington-Whiteley and Emily Ratajkowski in Gucci-by-Demna gowns. No platform-reported aggregate engagement figures accessible without a paid connector.

items.title: At the LACMA Art+Film Gala 2026, Demna's Gucci Steps Into the Spotlight
items.summary: Gucci-presented LACMA Art+Film Gala (Nov 7) drew over 600 guests and raised a record ~$7 million for the museum honoring Vija Celmins and Denis Villeneuve; Demna dressed Kim Kardashian, Timothee Chalamet and others. Co-chair Eva Chow announced this would be her final year leading the gala. Coverage is largely celebratory with no critical framing of the brand.

items.source: Weibo (cross-border resale commentary, visible to EU/global market watchers)
items.title: Gucci pricing-correction strategy discussion -- resale/secondary-market implications
items.summary: Chinese-language commentary (relevant to EU as a primary-market pricing signal that feeds cross-border resale/arbitrage activity watched by EU resellers) discusses Gucci's unusual 2025-2026 strategy of broad primary-price cuts (some lines down as much as 40%) rather than the industry's habitual price hikes, tied to the brand's heavy reliance on middle-class spend and the resulting pressure on resale margins versus Hermes/Chanel.

items.title: Gucci news tag page -- turnaround and revenue-loss context
items.summary: Aggregated FashionNetwork coverage reiterates that Gucci lost more than EUR4.5 billion in revenue between 2022 and 2025, falling below EUR6 billion last year, and frames current CEO Francesca Bellettini's efforts (store concept rollout, Demna collections) within Kering's wider 'Reconkering' restructuring led by Luca de Meo since September 2025.

coverage.note: No major EU daily (Le Figaro, Les Echos, Guardian, BBC, FAZ, Der Spiegel, Corriere, La Repubblica) ran a dedicated fresh Gucci-specific story in the 72h window per available search index; Reddit and Mumsnet/Doctissimo searches surfaced only stale or generic evergreen threads (2021-vintage or undated shopping-advice content) and were excluded rather than padded. Critical-angle searches (price-hike/backlash, quality complaints, resale-value drop, 'lost its way'/overrated framing, store closures) surfaced genuine material: ongoing Trustpilot service/quality complaints, PurseForum skepticism about Demna's archive-heavy direction, continued negative fan reaction to the Mariah Carey holiday campaign, and Chinese-language resale-market commentary on Gucci's unusual price-cut strategy versus the sector's habitual price hikes -- these are carried in the pool alongside the LACMA gala and Avenue Montaigne flagship activation coverage to avoid one-sided sampling. The AI-generated-campaign backlash story (Feb 2026) and the original Kering Q3 earnings release (Oct 22, 2026) were excluded from this date's pool as outside the 14-day freshness ceiling, though their follow-on coverage (Balenciaga leadership reset tied to Kering restructuring, Nov 7) was admitted as fresh.
